strategy: Elf blight-control — High Perfect Morcant + proliferate
identity: A BG attrition control deck with 12 Elf bodies and a counters-flavoured engine on top — and it is worth stating that honestly rather than overselling the engine. High Perfect Morcant reads 'Whenever High Perfect Morcant or another Elf you control enters, each opponent blights 1' and 'Tap three untapped Elves you control: Proliferate'. That is real but bounded: the OPPONENT chooses which of their creatures takes the counter, so each Elf entering is chip erosion aimed at their least valuable body rather than a removal spell, and against an empty opposing board the trigger does nothing. Proliferate can only deepen a counter that already exists — it cannot seed — so the nine interaction copies are what make it worth anything. What holds the deck together is the other direction: -1/-1 counters are a currency this deck SPENDS, because Blighted Blackthorn turns 'blight 2' into a card, Bogslither's Embrace's blight-1 additional cost lands on a Virulent Emissary or a Creakwood Safewright that sheds it, and Gnarlbark Elm is a removal spell whose magazine is counters sitting on itself. The game ends with Champions of the Perfect, Gloom Ripper, or a Creakwood Safewright that has grown to 5/5.

restrictions.build_constraint: at most 5 rare/mythic cards total across mainboard + sideboard

mainboard.name: High Perfect Morcant
mainboard.oracle_text:
Whenever High Perfect Morcant or another Elf you control enters, each opponent blights 1. (They each put a -1/-1 counter on a creature they control.)
Tap three untapped Elves you control: Proliferate. Activate only as a sorcery. (Choose any number of permanents and/or players, then give each another counter of each kind already there.)

mainboard.name: Gloom Ripper
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, target creature you control gets +X/+0 until end of turn and up to one target creature an opponent controls gets -0/-X until end of turn, where X is the number of Elves you control plus the number of Elf cards in your graveyard.

mainboard.name: Champions of the Perfect
mainboard.oracle_text:
As an additional cost to cast this spell, behold an Elf and exile it. (Exile an Elf you control or an Elf card from your hand.)
Whenever you cast a creature spell, draw a card.
When this creature leaves the battlefield, return the exiled card to its owner's hand.

mainboard.oracle_text: Put four -1/-1 counters on target creature.

mainboard.oracle_text:

mainboard.name: Blighted Blackthorn
mainboard.oracle_text: Whenever this creature enters or attacks, you may blight 2. If you do, you draw a card and lose 1 life. (To blight 2, put two -1/-1 counters on a creature you control.)

mainboard.oracle_text:

mainboard.oracle_text:

When this creature dies, return another target Elf card from your graveyard to your hand.

mainboard.name: Lys Alana Informant
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters or dies, surveil 1. (Look at the top card of your library. You may put it into your graveyard.)

mainboard.name: Eclipsed Elf
mainboard.oracle_text: When this creature enters, look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal an Elf, Swamp, or Forest card from among them and put it into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.

mainboard.oracle_text:
This creature enters with three -1/-1 counters on it.
At the beginning of your end step, if there is an Elf card in your graveyard and this creature has a -1/-1 counter on it, remove a -1/-1 counter from this creature.

strategy_es: control de blight con Elfos — High Perfect Morcant + proliferar
identity_es: Un control de desgaste BG con 12 cuerpos Elfo y un motor de sabor a contadores encima, y conviene decirlo con honestidad en lugar de sobrevender el motor. High Perfect Morcant dice 'Whenever High Perfect Morcant or another Elf you control enters, each opponent blights 1' y 'Tap three untapped Elves you control: Proliferate'. Eso es real pero limitado: el RIVAL elige cuál de sus criaturas se lleva el contador, así que cada Elfo que entra es erosión dirigida a su cuerpo menos valioso y no un hechizo de eliminación, y contra un tablero rival vacío el disparo no hace nada. Proliferar solo puede profundizar un contador que ya existe — no puede sembrarlo — así que las nueve copias de interacción son lo que le da valor. Lo que sostiene el mazo es la otra dirección: los contadores -1/-1 son una moneda que este mazo GASTA, porque Blighted Blackthorn convierte 'blight 2' en una carta, el coste adicional de blight 1 de Bogslither's Embrace aterriza sobre un Virulent Emissary o un Creakwood Safewright que lo suelta, y Gnarlbark Elm es un hechizo de eliminación cuyo cargador son contadores sentados sobre sí mismo. La partida termina con Champions of the Perfect, Gloom Ripper, o un Creakwood Safewright que ha crecido a 5/5.
